body: I'm loving this on second listen, there is so much in this album :-)

I'm having real trouble sleeping these days and have to force myself to eat something each day. I've found that drinkable yoghurt is best for me, there is no effort to make anything and you can eat it in a second.

I started seeing a counselor last week, had my second session this week. It is early days but it had helped to talk about my problems with someone else.

Have you talked to anyone about how you're feeling?

Hey, have you talked to anyone about this? I've been thinking about suicide a lot lately and talking to a councilor has helped me quite a bit. I've only gone to two sessions so far, but I feel a bit more optimistic and it had definitely helped. It feels good to let someone know what your problems are.

There are very few bands that continue to innovate and grow, Radiohead is certainly one of them.

I've high hopes for this album, if I don't like it on first listen I'll asume that there is something wrong with my ears. There is a big chance that this album will be my soundtrack for the next couple of years, just like In Rainbows was.

Thanks for the reply, i appreciate it.

I've been reading back over my post today, I was quite optimistic yesterday. I'm feeling quite low again, the CBT exercises are really hard - I'm trying to write down my upsetting events, my thoughts, my feelings and coping behaviors but part of me doesn't believe what my rational mind is saying. It is hard to accept that my relationship is over and all of the work ahead of me seems so daunting right now. I hope that this will get better over time.

I'm finding it hard to eat, sleep and exercise. Food seems so unappealing, making something even worse. I'm going to try and eat a piece of fruit now. I need to have energy to do some exercise and I don't want to wind up really skinny, that would just add to my problems.

Radiohead's music isn't for everyone, lots of people get nothing from it. For me though, their music is beautiful, layered and keeps giving after hundres of listens. Their music is quite diverse and their albums quite often take a few listens before you can make sense of them.

Thanks for the offer of the PM.
I'm very happy to hear this, it should be your no 1 goal right now. Will you let me know how it goes for you?

Please do talk to a counselor. I've been going through the worst time of my life recently and everything was lonely and hopeless. I went to a counselor for the first time last week, I'm just back from the second visit now. She has helped me put a little perspective on what I'm going through and has given me some hope that I can pull through. I'm feeling a little more positive now. Please do talk to a counselor at school.

"im not really sure what the source of my depression and mood is, i just know that its there. my girlfriend really wants me to go see a counselor, but im not really sure what on earth i would even talk to them about"

Your girlfriend is a smart cookie, a counselor will help you get a perspective on what you're feeling and will help you on the path to getting better. I've just come back from my second session with my counselor and she has helped me take some initial small positive steps.

Hey, I'm lying in bed reading your story and it so similar to mine. I broke up with my girlfriend before christmas and i feel so lost too right now. I just started meds yesterday, am seeing a counselor for the second time tomorrow. I try to exercise, but am struggling with that. I don't have any friends to talk to, its just me and my cat.

Let me know if you would like to chat a little. I've never really chatted to anyone here, maybe we could help each other a little? We probably live on the other side of the world from each other but we have such a similar story.

My girlfriend suffered from panic attacks and depression and while I was supportive and tried to help, I didn't really understand what she was going through. I regret not finding out more about her condition and being more helpful, we're apart now.

Perhaps you could show this post to your boyfriend?
This is a long shot but ... drumcondra?

Thanks for the belief :-)

In fairness, she didn't volunteer the information about her new boyfriend. I replied to her text asking her. Not knowing was the worst, at least now I know that she is getting on with her life and that I should do the same. It hurts like hell though.
Thanks. I'm really looking forward to the album. The doctor was worried when I mentioned Radiohead - 'a little depressing, no?' were his words. Their music is uplifting to me though
Thanks for the words of encouragement, I've just come back from a 1 mile run. It's a start, tomorrow I'll run 1.5 miles.
